# Kyoto 5-Day Walking Trip Plan

A relaxed Kyoto plan for **2 adults** from **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-16** within **¥180,000 total excluding flights**. It prioritizes **temples, food markets, and easy walking**, keeps to **one museum visit max**, and includes **one free afternoon**.

## Day-by-Day Itinerary Timeline

Day 1: Higashiyama arrival and gentle temple loop
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take a slow start around your hotel area.
- Afternoon: Walk the **Kiyomizu-dera → Sannenzaka → Ninenzaka** area at an easy pace.
- Evening: Dinner in Gion or Higashiyama; keep the first day light and close to your stay.

Day 2: Arashiyama riverside and market bites
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Visit **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** early, then continue to **Tenryu-ji**.
- Afternoon: Easy riverside walk, then snack stops near **Togetsukyo Bridge** and local cafes.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for a relaxed dinner.

Day 3: Central Kyoto food markets and shrine strolls
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Explore **Nishiki Market** for breakfast bites and local specialties.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Explore **Nishiki Market** for breakfast bites and local specialties, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Walk to **Nijo Castle** area or nearby temple grounds for low-effort sightseeing.
- Evening: Dinner around downtown Kawaramachi; optional dessert stop.

Day 4: Free afternoon built in, with one cultural anchor
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Visit **Fushimi Inari Taisha** only up to the lower, flatter sections.
- Afternoon: **Free afternoon** for rest, shopping, a cafe break, or an onsen-style bathhouse.
- Evening: Casual dinner near your accommodation or a train station hub.

Day 5: Final temple visit and departure buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- Morning: Choose one final easy stop such as **Kennin-ji** or **Kodai-ji**.
- Afternoon: Souvenir shopping, matcha stop, and airport/train transfer buffer.
- Evening: Departure day wrap-up; keep plans flexible.

## Budget Breakdown and Timeline Format

### Best chart format
Use **two separate charts**:
- **Timeline chart:** a horizontal **Gantt-style time block chart** for each day
- **Budget chart:** a **donut chart** or **stacked bar chart** for spending categories

Why this works:
- The timeline chart shows **how the day flows**
- The budget chart shows **where money goes** at a glance

### Spending breakdown
| Category | Planned Amount | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Lodging | ¥70,000 | 4 nights, comfortable mid-range stay |
| Food & drinks | ¥32,000 | Markets, cafes, dinners, snacks |
| Local transport | ¥12,000 | Subway, bus, occasional taxi |
| Admissions | ¥10,000 | Temples, castle, one museum max |
| Shopping & souvenirs | ¥18,000 | Tea, sweets, small gifts |
| Buffer / contingency | ¥38,000 | Weather, upgrades, extra meals |
| Total | **¥180,000** | Excluding flights |

### Daily budget target
| Day | Target Spend | Main Cost Driver |
|---|---:|---|
| Oct 12 | ¥34,000 | Hotel check-in, dinner, temple area transit |
| Oct 13 | ¥36,000 | Arashiyama transport, temple entry, meals |
| Oct 14 | ¥30,000 | Market food, local transit, admissions |
| Oct 15 | ¥28,000 | Light sightseeing, free afternoon, meals |
| Oct 16 | ¥52,000 | Final shopping, transfer buffer, departure costs |
| Total | **¥180,000** | Fits your full trip budget |

### Recommended time-block structure for the timeline chart
- **Morning:** sightseeing and temple visits
- **Afternoon:** walking loops, markets, or free time
- **Evening:** dinner and short neighborhood strolls
